verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev's Realtime API is explicitly documented for streaming live run updates and token/data streams from background tasks directly to a frontend without polling, including forwarding AI provider streams for real-time UI updates, and community feedback confirms hooks are used for returning progress updates to the UI during OpenAI calls. Missing for 10: independent hands-on frontend integration examples/demos beyond docs and one community mention, and no discussion of latency/scale limits of the realtime stream in practice.
